title: AgentX: on-chain lifecycle for autonomous AI agents
summary: Initialise a registry, register an agent PDA, activate it, commit an oracle-signed task result, then deactivate it.
what: AgentX is an Anchor program for the lifecycle of autonomous AI agents on Solana: a global registry, per-agent PDAs, oracle-signed task records and (optional) AGX reward claims. Upstream shipped no initialize instruction even though every other instruction requires the registry PDA, so this lab deployment adds initialize_registry. The hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet program.
app_note: The fork has no first-party frontend. The page at /dapps/agentx/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. initialize_registry is a lab patch.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentx/, switch to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare. Get free devnet SOL from faucet.solana.com if you need it.
try_steps.see: The page lists initialize_registry, register_agent, execute_task, update_state, claim_reward and deactivate_agent, and shows program 7cnrBzeF…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: initialize_registry is already done on this lab deployment. Fetch the registry PDA (seeds ["registry"]).
try_steps.see: authority is the lab wallet, registration_paused is false.

try_steps.do: register_agent with a fresh 8-byte agent_id, a short name and model, then update_state to Active.
try_steps.see: An agent PDA seeded by ["agent", owner, agent_id] starting Inactive, then Active.

try_steps.do: As the registry authority (oracle), submit execute_task with a result hash, a short summary, a reward and success=true.
try_steps.see: A task PDA and tasks_completed incremented.
try_steps.ran: execute_task sig M1vYKfRRx5y5B9f4rZWkGAQRiTUcMzTcMtxtJPAR8rWBDGad28Sf4yHF68P4WC3W8mUFHaYP7H7N7mMChpDbgxd wrote task 7MR2FKL5kAtpGt8bzcWm8wPVuAQ4HpULpBmqmBqfgUdR; tasks_completed=1, total_rewards=42.

try_steps.do: deactivate_agent, then try update_state back to Active.
try_steps.see: status=Deactivated; a later update is rejected with AgentDeactivated.
try_steps.ran: deactivate_agent sig YHeFy4nAV9tNAG8Kg6jGQ1ezwArfJuXhV6yQjmGDvAwSvN29g4Lybkw9BMCFy9t2LvPUB987cUHi3Ci6fstDagw; the lab run caught AgentDeactivated.

diagram:
admin ─ initialize_registry() ─▶ Registry PDA ["registry"]  (lab patch)
owner ─ register_agent(id, name, model) ─▶ Agent PDA ["agent", owner, id] (Inactive)
owner ─ update_state(Active)
oracle(=registry.authority) ─ execute_task(...) ─▶ Task PDA ["task", agent, nonce]
owner ─ deactivate_agent() ─▶ status=Deactivated (irreversible)
accounts: Authority, totals, AGX mint, registration_paused. Created by the lab initialize_registry patch.
Name, model, status, task counters, accrued rewards.
Oracle-submitted result hash, summary, reward, verified flag.

instructions.name: initialize_registry
steps: Lab patch. Creates the registry PDA and records the authority and AGX mint pubkey.

instructions.name: register_agent
steps: Creates the agent PDA, starting Inactive, and increments registry.total_agents.

instructions.name: update_state
steps: Owner-only. Cannot reactivate a Deactivated agent.

instructions.name: execute_task
steps: Oracle must be registry.authority; agent must be Active. Credits tasks_completed and total_rewards on success.

innovation.title: A shared on-chain identity and task log for autonomous agents
innovation.text: The interesting DeAI idea is a registry of agent PDAs plus oracle-signed task receipts that anyone can audit. Rewards accrue on the agent account; claiming them (AGX transfer) was not exercised here. The lab had to add initialize_registry because upstream omitted it.
innovation.more: claim_reward needs an AGX vault and was not sent.

frontend.title: Generic IDL console
steps: initialize_registry is already confirmed; fetch the registry.

exercises.title: Derive the agent PDA
steps: Seeds are ["agent", owner pubkey, 8-byte agent_id]. Use program id 7cnrBzeFJVWR54PXadfDzE9ZWy975TaCTfBTGVL5wi5K.
exercises.expect: It matches 6FtQojvNw9Uh1nyAHQwv8T74SaX3KxbwBzTceVNLqcMx for agent_id sc-deai1 and the lab owner.
exercises.hint: agent_id is raw 8 bytes, not a string account.

exercises.title: Why did the first execute_task fail?
steps: Read the AgentNotActive constraint on ExecuteTask.
exercises.expect: The agent starts Inactive; update_state to Active is required first.

not_covered: claim_reward was not sent (needs an AGX vault). The hosted UI was not clicked in headless Chromium in this run. initialize_registry is a lab patch.
objectives: Register, activate and deactivate an agent.
Explain why execute_task requires Active status and the registry authority as oracle.
prereqs: A wallet on Devnet with a little practice SOL.
Complete [Oculus](/lessons/oculus/) or equivalent Stage 2 progress — AgentX is next on the [learning path](/lessons/path/#stage-2). Comfort with PDAs and Anchor constraints.

build.note: Program id on this lab deployment is 7cnrBzeFJVWR54PXadfDzE9ZWy975TaCTfBTGVL5wi5K. initialize_registry is a lab patch.

student_outcome: Register and activate an agent, explain why execute_task needs Active status and the registry authority as oracle, then deactivate — without claiming unverified claim_reward mastery.

assessment.purpose: Determine whether the student can walk register → Active → oracle execute_task → deactivate, name the oracle=authority constraint, and stay honest that claim_reward was not verified.

criteria.title: Registers and activates an agent
criteria.question: Can the student fetch the registry, register an agent PDA, and update_state to Active?
criteria.not_yet: Skips activation or cannot name registry seeds ["registry"].
criteria.support: Correct after revisiting try steps / Proof.
criteria.independent: Fetches registry, registers with a fresh agent_id, activates, and reads status Active.
criteria.misconception: register_agent alone makes the agent executable.

criteria.title: Explains execute_task gates
criteria.question: Why can execute_task fail before Active — and who must sign as oracle?
criteria.not_yet: Expects any wallet to execute tasks, or ignores Active status.
criteria.support: Correct after revisiting Unauthorized / status checks.
criteria.independent: States agent must be Active and oracle.key() must equal registry.authority.
criteria.misconception: The agent wallet itself is always the oracle for execute_task.

criteria.title: Labels evidence and coverage honestly
criteria.question: Does the student distinguish Proof from their attempt, and avoid claiming claim_reward mastery?
criteria.not_yet: Claims AGX rewards claimed, or treats Proof as personal completion.

criteria.misconception: Any successful signature on the lesson page counts as my mastery of rewards.

criteria.title: Transfers to deactivate
criteria.question: Without re-reading the walkthrough: after deactivate_agent, what should happen if someone tries update_state back to Active or execute_task?
criteria.not_yet: Expects silent reactivation without constraints, or invents success.
criteria.support: States rejection paths after revisiting try step 5 / program checks.
criteria.independent: States deactivated agents cannot execute_task until properly returned to Active per program rules; records the observed reject if tried.
criteria.misconception: I finished because I followed the buttons once.

learning_loop.objective: Activate an AgentX agent — then explain why execute_task needs Active status and the registry authority as oracle.
learning_loop.predict_question: You just registered an agent PDA but have not called update_state to Active. The registry authority submits execute_task. What should happen?

predict_options.label: Fail — the agent must be Active first
Succeed only if the agent wallet co-signs as oracle

learning_loop.predict_why: execute_task requires the agent status to be Active and the oracle signer to equal registry.authority. register_agent creates the PDA; update_state to Active is a separate step. The agent wallet is not automatically the oracle.
learning_loop.act: In observation mode, open recorded register / activate / execute_task / deactivate under Proof. In practical mode on Devnet via /dapps/agentx/: fetch registry, register_agent, update_state to Active, execute_task as registry authority, then deactivate_agent. Prefer observation if you are not the lab registry authority. Do not treat claim_reward as required (needs AGX vault). Note initialize_registry is a lab patch upstream lacked.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must oracle.key() equal registry.authority on execute_task — and how is that different from the agent wallet signing check_spend-style actions in earlier labs?
learning_loop.transfer: Without re-reading the full walkthrough: after deactivate_agent, what should a later execute_task do, and why is claim_reward not part of this lab’s verified path?
